positive_mechanisms: The complete producer inventory and every listed hash are authenticated before execution.
Explicit dense UWFA model rows are complete, lexicographic and canonical.
The decode(original_freq1) path uses the serialized model and causally regenerated context.
Decoded payloads are required to re-encode to identical arithmetic bytes and logical lengths.
The parser rejects hostile integer ranges, overflow, gaps, overlaps, noncanonical row order, padding, roots, CRCs and frame hashes.
The six-expert/fifteen-frame topology is two private plus one pair-shared frame per expert.
The physical rate is an exact rational and the independent page-union/storage-share calculation matches and conserves all bytes.

semantic_scale_mutation.meaning: The synthetic callback hashes decisions rather than reconstructed numerical values.

untrusted_evidence_and_zero_mse.meaning: Evidence hashes are bound but not compared to trusted expected values, and this reference API does not independently recompute SSE/energy.

source_weight_geometry_mismatch.meaning: The global source-weight count is not tied to decoded block geometry.

rate_f_and_cold_gates_not_enforced.meaning: Verification returns flags and a ledger but does not reject violations of any of the three promotion gates.

post_complete_external_mutation.meaning: CompletionLastCapsule disables only its own API, not direct filesystem writes.

symlink_ancestor.meaning: CompletionLastCapsule is explicitly not the normative external bootstrap.

declared_reference_boundaries: The README explicitly excludes a real inherited-STRATA parser and inverse RHT/group/XKLT reconstruction callback; the fixture decision hash is only a stand-in.
The README explicitly states that CompletionLastCapsule is not the external authenticated bootstrap and omits ancestor-symlink, held-descriptor and immutable-snapshot protections.
The README and producer manifest explicitly deny Qwen/current/control payload authority and independent-audit authority.
The fixture deliberately uses synthetic source/bootstrap/evidence hashes and a literal MSE fixture value.
The source-only reference does not implement the frozen 150-cell selection pipeline or matched-Gaussian controls required of the eventual experiment.
unadvertised_blocking_defects: No verifier input or API compares bound evidence hashes against trusted expected hashes.
source_weights is not constrained to equal the restored block geometry or total decision count.
parse/verify do not enforce the 2.15-to-2.5 bpw, F<=0.8, or cold-read<2 promotion gates; callers can receive a normal verification object for a packet violating all three.
normative_missing_components: Real literal inherited-STRATA metadata validation and full inverse reconstruction.
Independent original-BF16 FP64 SSE and source-energy scoring.
Trusted expected binding comparison for baseline artifact, plan, audit, universal decoder, source manifest and bootstrap.
Frozen whole-artifact/holdout selection plus the complete symmetric matched-Gaussian control pipeline.
Separately pinned launcher with symlink-ancestor rejection, held descriptors, immutable execution, post-run identity verification and COMPLETE-last enforcement.
conclusion: The reference bridge mechanisms pass their source-free tests, but the package is a hard BLOCK for launch or UWFA-SC v2 integrated-container conformance. It is not Qwen evidence and grants no payload authority.
